introHtml: When you choose custom plastic plastic vinyl, you get the durability and lightweight feel of plastic combined with the versatility of vinyl. This material is ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, and giveaways where you need items that resist moisture and wear. Options like the 16 oz Roadster Mug or the 24 oz Biggie Tumbler can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or pad printing, ensuring your brand stands out.
